kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-layer7-rule --domain www.aliyun.com --rs-type 0 --real-servers example-string --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigLayer7Rule

parameters.help_en: The domain name that you want to manage
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The protocol array. The following describes the structure:

ProxyType: String type. Required. The protocol type. Valid values: http, https, websocket, websockets.
ProxyPorts: Integer type. Required. The protocol port
parameters.help_zh:
协议数组。具体结构描述如下：

ProxyType，String类型，必选，协议类型，取值：http、https、websocket、websockets。
ProxyPorts，Integer类型，必选，协议端口
parameters.name: proxy_type_list

parameters.help_en:
The origin server type. Valid values:

0: IP
1: domain name
parameters.name: rs_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the origin server. If multiple origin server IP addresses exist, pass them in sequence: RealServers.1, RealServers.2, RealServers.3,
parameters.help_zh: 源站IP。若有多个源站IP，依次传入RealServers.1, RealServers.2, RealServers.3,
parameters.name: real_servers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance to associate. If multiple instances exist, pass them in sequence: InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3, ...

If you do not specify this parameter, only the domain name is added without being associated with a specific IP address
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的实例Id。若有多个实例，依次传入InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3, ...

若不传入该参数，则只添加域名，不绑定到具体IP
parameters.name: instance_ids
